R2113.summary: Cornelis Haga, Dutch ambassador at Constantinople, reports that the Porte would let Transylvania be resigned to Bethlen Gábor's brother, that Transylvania must keep good correspondence with Hungary, and that the Turks would think better of the Hungarians if they too elected a king of Bohemia; the Grand Vizier, Capitan Bassa and Mufti press him on whether the States mean to extend the truce with Spain, make peace or take up arms again. No sign-level transcription of the cipher spans exists; the reading gives them deciphered in braces, and the images are on the DECODE record.
R2113.en:
The Tatars/Turks and a tribute or war with Poland ("to the payment of a yearly tribute, or to fall into open war with
this mighty monarchy"); talks with the Emperor's ambassador over important fortresses in Hungary. The Turks promise
help to Bethlen, Prince of Transylvania, and to Hungary. The ambassador of the Hungarian Estates had no audience with
His Imperial Majesty's [the Sultan's] representatives, "mainly because no one has any advantage from the Turks".
Closing formula, then signature.

... and intention of [1] has declared, and besides that [...] that we shall be well content ⟨to let the resignation
to his Highness's brother⟩ take place. It is in all ways necessary that the same province ⟨with Hungary and its⟩
[?joined] ...

R2115.summary: Two letters. 24 April: Bohemian and Hungarian commissioners from the Pressburg Easter diet received by the Grand Vizier and the Sultan; in cipher, nothing is more necessary than gaining time and that the Hungarian Estates elect and crown a new king; the letter of Bethlen Gábor printed at Cologne to make him odious is a forgery; Naples too exhausted to help the Emperor. May: Haga has turned the Grand Vizier and the chief lords in favour of the King of Bohemia and of Transylvania; the Porte's letters promise perpetual peace; order given to the Bassa of Buda to assist; the Vizier and Mufti urge Bethlen to accept the crown of Hungary; the honour belongs to the States General alone; the chiaus to the Emperor's ambassador is delayed, 'om het spel in Duijtslant ende Ungaria met sodanigen bulleman te verderven'; Polish ambassador, Cossacks, Tatar invasion of Poland expected.
R2115.en:
High and Mighty, Gracious Lords.

On the [?16th] of this month two Bohemian and Hungarian [?commissioners] arrived here, sent from the Easter diet at
Pressburg on behalf of the confederated lands, bringing letters and reports of all that was treated and decided at that
diet, among other things that they intend to send a formal embassy to this Porte and to make a perpetual peace with
His Imperial Majesty [the Sultan].

[?This] was so welcome that they [?enjoyed] a princely reception and quick introduction both to the Grand Vizier and to
His Majesty, by whom not only these [?commissioners] but also the ambassador of the Estates of Hungary (whom the
persuasion of the German Emperor's ambassador had kept back until now) had public audience on [?…];
